# Halyard Films billing: 10 March 2026

**HALYARD FILMS**

| | |

| **Project** | Marlow Bikes 90-second brand film (SOW signed 28 Jan 2026) |
| **Bill to** | Marlow Bikes, Attn: Jane Doe, ap@marlowbikes.example.com, [Marlow billing address] |

| # | Description | Qty | Rate | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fixed fee: one 90-second brand film (delivered 10 Mar 2026) | 1 | $18,000.00 | $18,000.00 |
| 2 | CO-1: extra shoot day (approved by Jane Doe, email 20 Feb 2026) | 1 day | $1,400.00 | $1,400.00 |
| 3 | Drone rental: $640.00 cost + 10% handling ($64.00) | 1 | $704.00 | $704.00 |
| 4 | Travel (mileage): $186.00 cost + 10% handling ($18.60) | 1 | $204.60 | $204.60 |

| | **Subtotal** | | | **$20,693.60** |
| | Sales tax (not applicable) | | | $0.00 |
| | **Total project charges** | | | **$20,693.60** |
| | Less: deposit received 2 Feb 2026 (INV-0141) | | | −$9,000.00 |
| | **BALANCE DUE by 25 March 2026** | | | **$11,693.60** |

**How each line was calculated**
- Line 1: the fixed fee per the SOW. The 50% deposit ($9,000) was invoiced as INV-0141 and paid, so the remaining 50% is $9,000.
- Line 2: 1 day × $1,400 = $1,400.
- Line 3: $640 × 1.10 = $704.00.
- Line 4: $186 × 1.10 = $204.60.
- Line 5: $350 × 1.10 = $385.00.
- Expenses total $1,293.60. Check: $18,000 + $1,400 + $1,293.60 = $20,693.60. Less $9,000 = $11,693.60.

**Not included**
- Crew meals ($212) are not billable under the SOW.
- CO-2 (30-second cut-down) is not billed because it has no written approval from the named contact. See the email below.

**Payment instructions**
Bank transfer: [Bank name] · Account name: Halyard Films · Account/IBAN: [number] · Routing/SWIFT: [code] · Reference: INV-0152. [Alternative: card/payment link]

**Terms**
- Net 15 days from the invoice date.
- Overdue balances accrue a late fee of 1.5% per month.
- Questions: hello@halyardfilms.example.com.

## 2. Email to Jane Doe

**To:** ap@marlowbikes.example.com
**Subject:** Marlow Bikes brand film: final invoice INV-0152 and a question on the cut-down

Hi Jane,

The brand film was delivered today. Thank you for a great project. Final invoice INV-0152 is attached: **$11,693.60, due 25 March 2026**. It covers the remaining 50% of the fixed fee, CO-1 (the extra shoot day you approved on 20 Feb), and the drone rental, mileage and permit at cost plus 10%. The deposit is already credited, and crew meals are not charged.

One item is **not** on this invoice. John Doe asked us on 3 March for an extra 30-second cut-down (0.5 day, **$700** at our day rate). Our SOW requires change orders to be approved in writing by you, so we haven't billed it. If you'd like it, please reply confirming approval and we'll invoice it separately as CO-2. If not, there's nothing further to do and no charge.

Best regards,
[Name]
Halyard Films

---

## 3. Collection emails

**Chase:** INV-0133 (Pellworth) and INV-0137 (Saltgrass, corrected invoice). **Don't chase:** INV-0139 (Tern), which was paid on 3 Mar.

### INV-0133: Pellworth Coffee (firm, contractual)

**Subject:** Overdue: INV-0133, $4,326.00, payment required by 17 March

Hello [Name],

Invoice INV-0133 ($4,200) was due on 5 January and is now over two months overdue. We sent reminders on 15 January and 5 February and haven't heard back.

Under the late-fee clause in our agreement (1.5% per month), $126.00 has accrued so far, making the amount due **$4,326.00**. A further $63.00 will accrue on 5 April and each month after while the balance is unpaid.

Please pay by **17 March 2026**, or reply by then if there is a problem with the invoice. If we hear nothing, we will pause any further work for Pellworth and move to formal collection steps.

Payment details are attached. Thank you,
[Name], Halyard Films

### INV-0137: Saltgrass Council (warm, no late fee)

**Subject:** INV-0137 reissued with PO 77-3310

Hello [Name],

Thanks again for your continued work with us. Looking back at INV-0137 ($6,750, due 15 February), we realised the invoice didn't carry your purchase order number. That was our oversight, and it may be why your AP team couldn't process it.

A corrected copy is attached showing **PO 77-3310**. The amount and invoice number are unchanged. Could you pass it to AP and let us know when payment is scheduled? If anything else is needed on our side, tell me and we'll fix it right away.

Kind regards,
[Name], Halyard Films

---

## 4. Updated AR (as of 10 March 2026)

| Invoice | Client | Amount | Due | Status | Next follow-up |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| INV-0133 | Pellworth Coffee | $4,200 + $126 late fee = $4,326.00 | 5 Jan | **Overdue, 64 days.** Third notice sent with late fee; deadline 17 Mar | 18 Mar: if unpaid, escalate (phone call to the owner/AP, pause work, formal demand). Next fee accrual 5 Apr |
| INV-0137 | Saltgrass Council | $6,750.00 | 15 Feb | **Overdue (admin).** Corrected invoice with PO 77-3310 sent; no late fee (none in contract) | 17 Mar: confirm AP has it and ask for a payment date |
| INV-0139 | Tern Studios | $2,300.00 | 28 Feb | **Paid 3 Mar** (TERN ST PMT 0193). Closed | None |
| INV-0152 | Marlow Bikes | $11,693.60 | 25 Mar | **Issued today**, current | 23 Mar: courtesy reminder. 26 Mar: overdue notice if unpaid |
| CO-2 (not invoiced) | Marlow Bikes | $700.00 potential | n/a | Awaiting Jane Doe's written approval | 17 Mar: follow up once if there is no reply |

**Notes and assumptions**
- The $1,140 deposit on 6 Mar is retail stock-footage revenue. It is not applied to any invoice.
- Tern paid 3 days late. That is under one month, so I treated no late fee as due.
- Pellworth's fee is simple interest for two completed months (5 Jan to 5 Mar): $4,200 × 1.5% × 2 = $126. If the contract allows pro-rating or compounding, the figure would be slightly higher.
- Mileage is treated as billable travel at cost, with 10% handling.
- Total outstanding: $22,769.60 ($4,326.00 + $6,750.00 + $11,693.60), of which $11,076.00 is overdue.
